name: Orange wall strips
evidence: Visual classification: two repeated orange horizontal strips are visible above the Scene 19 pool tables in Plane A and in longplay frames section_09/frame_006990 and frame_007035. They share table metatile cells but are outside the table's collision footprint; they are separate source-art parts, not part of the table object. The ROM does not assign an interaction, animation, or sound to these pixels. The source metatiles also combine the strips with the map texture, so the viewer preserves their pixels and keeps them anchored until an exact underlay is sourced.
